verdict.rationale: Paddle documents a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 specification for the Billing API, maintained at github.com/PaddleHQ/paddle-openapi (v1/openapi.yaml), plus an importable Postman collection covering every operation. The probe's 404s on guessed well-known paths do not contradict this, because the documented spec is hosted in the GitHub repo rather than at those URLs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec downloads and is complete (no probe hit on the actual spec file).
